purpose: Two-layer pipeline: 3D block-out previs (motion/framing/timing) -> r2v rv2v conversion (look/materials/effects). Not an importable workflow; does not replace production clip06.

pipeline.step1: Author a gray low-poly 3D block-out video per 3d-blockout/*.txt, 24 fps, recommended 960x540, place in ComfyUI/input with *-source-*f.mp4 naming
pipeline.step2: Director: r2v + ref2va model; attach the block-out as Video 1 and Pictures 1-5 as identity; paste groups/ prompt with Shared Params ON
